headline: Database-scale pangenome and genome-catalog tools reveal microbial systems and diversity
label: Microbial Genome Mining Diversity
summary: Genome collections now reach millions of bacterial sequences, making scalable system annotation and cross-species pangenome comparison practical.
synthesis: The dominant thread is sequence-based discovery and comparison of microbial genomic content at scale. PANORAMA annotates macromolecular systems such as phage defense and compares pangenomes across Pseudomonas and Enterobacteriaceae, while ZSeekerDB catalogs over 850 million putative Z-forming loci from more than 280,000 genome assemblies with coordinates, Z-scores and taxonomy. gemsparcl clusters 5.6 million bacterial genomes and MAGs into GCUs using sketchlib.rust MinHash with MAG completeness correction. PG-SCUnK scores pangenome graph representativeness by counting single-copy and universal k-mers from source assemblies. RefLA contributes reference-guided long-read assembly, and the graph-based AMR profiling study compares gene detection across long and short-read metagenomes; these sit at the methodological edge of the thread. What is new is the pairing of database-scale coverage with tools that annotate and compare diverse systems across genomes.
